name: Ballygowan
questions: Can you send a floor plan or a room list with sizes? Which bedrooms sit next to a bathroom, is either bathroom an ensuite, and how is the floored attic reached (fixed stairs or a Stira)?
What are the BER's kWh/m²/yr figure and its date, how old is the oil boiler, and what did oil and solid fuel cost last year?
Is drainage a septic tank or a treatment unit, how old is it, and is there a recent water test for the private well?
Are the boundaries fenced and gated all round (for two dogs), and does the gate open onto the lane or the road?
BuyerIQ flags one critical and five high-priority findings for this Eircode: has the site ever flooded, and has a radon test been done?

ai.why: A turnkey single-storey 4-bed of 137 m² at €380k, BER C, set back off a quiet local road with fields on three sides and a GP 4 km away. Against it: 0.54 acres is half the land target, the local primary has 21 pupils, and the ED, a strong secondary and Dublin trains are all 25–30 minutes or more.

electricity.detail: Likely connected; not stated, but it is a lived-in house with an alarm system and oil central heating.

water.detail: Private well, as stated in the listing; ask for a recent water quality test.

sewer.detail: Unknown; not stated, but a rural one-off house on a private well is almost certainly on a septic tank or treatment unit.

internet.detail: Fibre likely: BuyerIQ lists 'Fast broadband — 387 Mb full fibre' for this Eircode (detail behind its paywall). The listing doesn't mention broadband, and no NBI announcement names Kilmoganny or Tullahought; confirm on nbi.ie by Eircode.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Single-storey bungalow: all four bedrooms and both bathrooms are listed on one level, and the floored attic is for storage; there is no floor plan, so which bedroom is nearest a bathroom is unconfirmed.

bedsNote: Single storey; four bedrooms, two bathrooms; floored attic (storage, uses subject to regulations)
heating: Oil-fired central heating plus a solid-fuel stove
tagline: A turnkey four-bed bungalow of 137 m² on 0.54 acres with Slievenamon views, about 4 km south of Kilmoganny and 11 km from Carrick-on-Suir.

pros.detail: About €2,774/m²; stamp duty about €3,800. A similar 4-bed bungalow nearby (Woodbrook, Shrughawadda) sold for €435k in Sept 2025.
Four bedrooms and two bathrooms on one level, so the parents get a ground-floor room with no stairs, and the house sleeps six.
Listed as turnkey with a modern kitchen and bathrooms, PVC double glazing, oil central heating plus a stove, and an alarm; BER C (EPI not shown).

pros.text: Set back off a quiet local road, fields around
pros.detail: Satellite imagery shows the house about 30 m back from an unclassified local road beside a lane, with fields on the north, west and east and the nearest neighbour about 50 m across the junction.

pros.text: Large steel shed with water and WC
pros.detail: Plus a block fuel shed and a decked area: workshop, dog room or bike store.
Kilmoganny Health Centre (Mill Street, two GPs) is about 4 km north; Carrick-on-Suir (11 km) has the full set of supermarkets.

cons.text: 0.54 acres, about half the land target
cons.detail: About 0.22 ha, a long narrow plot roughly 70 × 30 m on the satellite view; a good garden for dogs but short of the ~1 acre aim, and the fields around are not part of it.
St Eoghan's NS, Kilmoganny has about 21 pupils (9 boys) per the Department; Windgap's St Nicholas's (~117 pupils, ~5 km) is the bigger option. No inspection reports retrieved.

cons.text: Strong secondary and ED 25–30 minutes away
cons.detail: Edmund Rice (boys, ~316) and Comeragh College (mixed) are in Carrick-on-Suir, ~11 km, with no reliable progression figures; St Kieran's Kilkenny is ~27 km. Clonmel, Waterford and Kilkenny EDs are each ~25–27 km straight-line.
Thomastown (~16 km straight-line) has about 7 Heuston trains a weekday at roughly 1h50–1h55; Carrick-on-Suir station has no direct Dublin trains.
Daft's map pin sits about 4 km south of Kilmoganny (pop. ~245), nearer Tullahought (2 km): every errand is a drive.

cons.text: Septic, attic access and floor plan unconfirmed
cons.detail: Drainage isn't stated, no room sizes or plan are on Daft (no MyHome copy found), and the floored attic's access is not described.
One critical and five high-priority findings sit behind BuyerIQ's €39 paywall (flood, radon, noise and air are in that section); ask the agent about flooding and radon.
